PART A · EXPERIMENTAL METHODOLOGIES Conduction of an experiment, step by step 1 Faculty introduces the title of the experiment. 2 Students relate the title to the topic covered in the classroom. 3 Equipment and accessories are displayed and the session opens for two-way interaction. 4 Students study the connection diagram and wire the circuit themselves, without power supply. 5 Faculty verifies the connections and suggests corrections, if required. 6 Faculty explains the connections to the whole batch. 7 Each group performs the experiment and takes readings while operating the equipment. 8 The next group repeats it with the faculty and the previous group’s team leader present.
